overview: Harvey builds AI products for law firms, in-house legal teams, and professional-services organizations.

bear_case: Legal incumbents and general-purpose AI platforms compete for the same high-value workflow surface.

intelligence.why_it_matters: Legal AI is a useful test of whether vertical software can build a defensible product layer on top of foundation models. Harvey's customer base makes it one of the category's most consequential private companies.
